name: Trioedd Ynys Prydain
text: Trioedd Ynys Prydain is the Welsh title meaning the triads of the island of Britain. The dictionary prints the head as a two-line routing entry. It points readers to the Triads record for the fuller discussion. That record covers the Welsh and Irish triadic tradition and its scholarship.
